proposal.summary: A vulnerability in com.full.dialer.top.secure.encrypted up to version 1.0.1 for Android allows any installed application with no permissions to place phone calls without user interaction by sending a crafted intent to com.full.dialer.top.secure.encrypted.activities.DialerActivity.
proposal.cwe_quote: enables any installed application (with no permissions) to place phone calls without user interaction by sending a crafted intent via the com.full.dialer.top.secure.encrypted.activities.DialerActivity component.

AV.quote: enables any installed application (with no permissions) to place phone calls without user interaction by sending a crafted intent via the com.full.dialer.top.secure.encrypted.activities.DialerActivity component.

UI.quote: place phone calls without user interaction

A.quote: place phone calls without user interaction

proposal.recommended_next_step: Verify the vulnerable component handles incoming intents with proper permission or caller validation; reproduce by sending crafted intents to DialerActivity on an affected version and implement a fix to require appropriate permission check or explicit user confirmation before placing calls.
